messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [P1] High latency observed on inference-runtime-prod. Auto-page triggered to #eng-oncall. Incident INC-20260314-72. Primary on-call: Alex Chen. Please ack and follow runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-spike

Alex Chen: Acked. I'm primary and I'm looking. Starting with quick health checks and tailing logs.

Alex Chen: Quick snapshot — 95th pct latency jumped from 120ms -> 2.3s around 02:03 UTC. Error rates still low but timeouts to GPU pool increasing.

Maria Gomez: I'm secondary, standing by. If you need escalation to infra or RTX pool owners ping me and I'll take it.

Alex Chen: Copy. Running health checks: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=runtime -o wide` then `kubectl logs -f runtime-abc -c runtime | grep \"KV cache miss\"`.

Devon Patel: Noticed autoscaler didn't spin up new nodes for burst yesterday in canary. Could be scale policy mismatch with reserved pools. Attaching quick check:
```
# last 6 lines from scaler
2026-03-14T02:01:34Z scaler INFO desired=12 current=8 pending=0
2026-03-14T02:02:05Z scaler WARN insufficient-capacity: zone-a
2026-03-14T02:03:10Z scaler INFO desired=12 current=8 pending=4
```

Alex Chen: Interesting — pending increased but effective capacity stuck. Could be quota or provisioning delay. I'm bumping fallback to model-quantized variant to reduce GPU pressure. Rolling partial config change now (canary small subset).

Samira Khan: Heads up — customer impact assessment in progress. Early signals: a few customers hitting tail latency for interactive flows (chat endpoints). No mass 5xx yet. I'm opening a ticket to track customers and comms.

Samira Khan: Created Jira RWI-4012 to track impacted tenants + comms. Owners: Samira (comm), Alex (mitigation), Devon (infra follow-up).

Alex Chen: Mitigation step applied: routing rule temporarily sends 20% of traffic to quantized-v2 model and decreases beamwidth for heavy requests. Monitoring.

Maria Gomez: Noted — for handoff in ~30m I can own primary if you need to step out. Also Devon, can you add a short blurb in the runbook about the scaler pending state? I saw nothing explicit.

Devon Patel: Yep adding a section now. Patch link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-spike#scaler-pending (draft). Also filing infra ticket INFRA-1297 for autoscaler issue.

Jules (SRE): Quick prod note — if we end up with GPU pool saturation repeatedly, we should enable burst capacity config `reserved_pool.burst: true` for this customer tier. That requires a config change and capacity commit.

Alex Chen: Latency improving for canary after fallback — 95p down to 340ms on quantized route. Rolling to 50% while we confirm.

Samira Khan: Customer update: sent templated DM to top 5 affected accounts. No customer escalations yet, helpdesk flagged 2 tickets referencing slowness.

Alex Chen: Ok I'm going to hand off primary to Maria at 02:40 UTC for the next shift. Current status: mitigated via quantized fallback (partial routing), autoscaler pending state under investigation, tickets RWI-4012 and INFRA-1297 opened. Retrospective needed to cover autoscaler behavior and runbook gaps.

Maria Gomez: Taking over primary at 02:40 UTC. Alex — please paste any outstanding commands or checks I should run on handoff.

Alex Chen: Copy. On handoff:
- Confirm fallback routing metrics (look at /dashboards/runtime/latency - panel QuantizedRoute)
- Confirm autoscaler queue: `gcloud compute operations list --filter=\"status:RUNNING AND zone:zone-a\"` and `kubectl get hpa -n inference runtime-hpa -o yaml`
- Tail runtime logs for ERR/timeout for 10m: `kubectl logs -n inference -l app=runtime --since=10m | grep -E \"timeout|ERROR|KV cache miss\"`
- Keep RWI-4012 updated with customer notes and comms
- Contact Devon if pending stays >5m and capacity doesn't change

Maria Gomez: Got it. Also note I have a 03:30 UTC calendar block where I will be unavailable for 25m (doctor appt). Devon, can you cover that gap?

Devon Patel: I can cover 03:30-04:00 UTC. I'll monitor the autoscaler and be on call.

Samira Khan: Adding follow-ups to RWI-4012: action items are (1) infra: investigate scaler pending and provisioning delays (INFRA-1297), (2) runbook: add scaler troubleshooting + sample `kubectl` checks, (3) product: evaluate enabling burst config for enterprise tiers, (4) ops: add synthetic test for quantized fallback correctness.

Jules (SRE): Suggest we schedule a 30m post-mortem tomorrow 10:00 UTC. I'll create the retro doc and invite Alex, Maria, Devon, Samira, and infra leads.

Alex Chen: Thanks — I'm back on-call in support if anything pops while I step out but handoff stands. Leaving session notes in RWI-4012.

Maria Gomez: Hand-off complete at 02:40 UTC. I'm primary. Monitoring panels and logs.

Samira Khan: I'll own comms until incident is closed. Will post a short status update in the customers channel and update the ticket.

Devon Patel: Quick note — I've attached a small debug snippet to INFRA-1297 showing provisioning latencies and account quotas.

Maria Gomez: Current tick — 03:55 UTC, latency stable at 200-400ms 95p, no new errors. Tickets: RWI-4012 (customer comms) and INFRA-1297 (autoscaler) remain open. Proposed retro: 2026-03-15 10:00 UTC.

Samira Khan: Confirmed retro time. I'll add agenda: timeline, immediate mitigations, runbook gaps, capacity/contract implications, comms timeline.

Alex Chen: Post-handoff follow-ups I promised to do: add notes to runbook about quick-fallback commands and update RWI-4012 with my mitigation timeline. Will do within 2 hours.

Maria Gomez: Thanks everyone. If anything degrades I'll escalate. Otherwise I'll close incident in incident-bot once INFRA-1297 has a concrete fix plan and latency back to baseline for 1 hour. :white_check_mark:
